decision: Do not merge the broad reusable-module scalar-register promotion. One required unchanged-budget canonical outcome remains a timeout. Self-build counter tradeoffs do not demonstrate a real-workload win. Preserve the candidate for narrower evidence-driven work; continue independent ordered-set runtime specialization.
